```
def compute_corr_fft(h):
    # h: ndarray of shape (n,)
    # returns correlation array (size 2n-1)
    # Using FFT convolution of reversed h and (1-h)
    h_rev = h[::-1]
    b = 1.0 - h
    L = 2 * len(h) - 1
    # compute with np.fft.fft size L, but may benefit from next power of two for speed.
    H = np.fft.fft(h_rev, L)
    B = np.fft.fft(b, L)
    corr = np.fft.ifft(H * B).real
    return corr
```
